backend/main.mo: Main actor defining the shop backend with user profiles, products (including UnitType enum), orders, recharge orders, carts, bills, and access control; includes authorization mixins and blob storage integration.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module for upgrading actor state from old Product schema (without unitType) to new Product schema (with unitType field), including conversion functions for products, orders, cart items, and bills.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: Unit Type dropdown in AdminProductForm, custom weight input for Kg/Gram products, +/- buttons for Packet/Piece products, and unit type display across all product components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages, highlighting unit-type-aware UI changes in ProductCard, CartDrawer, AdminProductForm, and checkout flows with weight parsing and formatting utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining color schemes for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, camera permission description, manifest link, and SEO metadata for Maa Bhawani General Store application.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, display mode, and orientation for Maa Bhawani General Store progressive web app.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with cache versioning and cleanup on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the application router using TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and settings pages, all wrapped in a Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Implements authentication guard for admin pages with hardcoded credentials, session management (24-hour duration), Internet Identity integration, and principal verification with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Provides a form for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, unit type, barcode, and image upload with progress tracking; validates inputs and checks for duplicate barcodes.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality; includes confirmation dialog for deletion and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Implements a live barcode scanner using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN, with camera controls, flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sounds, and scan cooldown to prevent duplicate scans.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays a searchable table of all generated bills with customer details, timestamps, and actions to view, print, or export bills to CSV format.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: React component that renders a printable bill template with shop header, bill details, itemized product list, and total amount. Fetches shop slogan via useGetShopSlogan hook and formats timestamps for display.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button component in the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to 9142876085 when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer component displaying cart items with quantity/weight editing, increment/decrement controls, and checkout functionality. Handles weight-based products with kg/gram parsing and formatting, includes swipe-to-close gesture support.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable category filter component that displays category buttons and highlights the selected category.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information: free delivery within 1km, ₹20 per km beyond that.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary class component that catches rendering errors, displays error details with stack trace, and provides reset/home navigation buttons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying store information, contact details with phone/map links, delivery info, and copyright notice with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with store logo, navigation links, cart button with item count badge, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity. Includes CartDrawer integration.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and CallUsButton with a gradient background and centers main content.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Form component for mobile recharge orders with fields for phone number, operator selection, and amount. Validates input and submits recharge orders via usePlaceRechargeOrder hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment card with QR code image, amount to pay in rupees, and step-by-step UPI payment instructions including a contact number.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a product card with image, category badges, price, and add-to-cart functionality; supports both unit-based and weight-based (kg/gram) quantity input with parsing logic.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a grid of product cards with category filtering and loading skeletons; fetches all products and filters by selected category.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages backend actor creation with optional authentication identity; initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart management, orders, order status updates, recharge orders, and bills with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with warm earthy color palette for light/dark themes, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer styles (80mm), and barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for managing orders, recharge orders, bills, and products. Provides order status updates (confirm, pack, out for delivery, complete) and displays revenue statistics.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring shop slogan and displaying a preview of the bill template with mock data. Includes navigation back to admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Point-of-sale billing page supporting barcode scanning (camera or manual entry) to add products to bills. Handles quantity adjustments, customer details, and bill generation with print functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page for placing orders with delivery details (name, phone, address, distance). Calculates total price including delivery fees and supports UPI or cash-on-delivery payment methods.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a hero banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing available groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing order ID and payment instructions. Displays UPI QR code for online payment or cash-on-delivery details based on selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: React component displaying store information including contact details, location map, delivery policy, hours, and services for Maa Bhawani General Store. Includes embedded Google Maps iframe and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support. Includes functions to get, store, clear, and persist parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for an e-commerce application with product management featuring flexible unit types (Kg, Gram, Packet, Piece). Contains architectural notes, existing features, and pending feature requests for unit-based quantity handling.
